title: A tea, coffee or water with no values on its pack is saved as 0, without a question
why: Coach Milan 22 November 2026, 16:22 to 17:35, after an onboarding call: a tester scanned a tea; the barcode was read right, but it could not be saved because there were no values. A zero food is already a real food (sweeteners, 0.2.21; zero cola). Drinks and spices can be part of a dish, not only on the side (his brownie with zero cola). 17:35: for a food that is obviously 0 kcal like a tea, no question and no other check; it is noted as a tea or similar and saved; asking to confirm would sound weird. Later on 22 November: a product that is read but has no values gets no heads-up today; the person should be told it cannot be saved yet, and that the values can be typed by hand.

opportunity.job: Scan my tea and use it, on the side or in a dish.
opportunity.kind: A bug: a product read correctly cannot be saved.
opportunity.why_now: Every new tester scans what is in the kitchen, and tea and coffee are there.

problem: EU label law does not require a nutrition table on tea, herbal tea, coffee, water, salt, herbs and spices. Their values come back empty, not zero. The app treats empty as unknown and refuses to save: Energy and protein are required.
story: When I scan a tea, I want it saved at once, so that I can add it to my snack or use it in a recipe like any other food.
proposed: A product read from a barcode or a pack, with no values, whose category or name says tea, herbal tea, coffee, water or salt, is saved as 0 kcal and 0 protein with no question, marked no values on the pack. From then on it is like zero cola: a drink on the side, or an ingredient in a dish with its grams and no energy. No protein density is shown for it. Any other product with no values gets a heads-up line: the name is read, the database has no values, type them from the pack. Saving it empty still stops, as today.
open: Which words or categories make a product obviously 0: from the product database's category first, then the name in English, German and Serbian.
checks: Area: Foods and the scan. The unit tests with new ones for the rule, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC8, and every walkthrough that scans or saves a food, about 10 minutes. New lines, so the German sweep too.
decision: Open. Drawn 22 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: A barcode is read and the database answers with a name and no values. The label check shows every value empty and the box I checked the values. Confirm & save stops: Energy and protein are required to calculate PD, and Confirm the label and per-100-g basis before saving.
looked_at: A line the person taps to count it as 0: not chosen, 17:35, for a food that is obviously 0 a question sounds weird. Offering 0 for any product with no values: not chosen, a biscuit with a missing entry must not become 0 by mistake.

ac.title: A tea with no values counts as 0
ac.text: Given I scan a tea whose database entry has a name and no values, when the label check opens, then one line says A tea has no values on its pack. It counts as 0, energy, fat, carbohydrate and protein show 0, and there is no box I checked the values

ac.title: Saved with no question
ac.text: Given the label check of that tea, when I tap Confirm & save, then it is saved with 0 kcal and 0 protein, its notes say No values on the pack, and nothing else is asked

ac.title: Coffee, herbal tea, water and salt too
ac.text: Given the database's category or the name says coffee, herbal tea, water or salt, in English, German or Serbian, when it has no values, then it is handled as the tea in AC1 and AC2

ac.title: No PD, in words
ac.text: Given such a food is saved, when its card or its label check shows protein density, then it says No PD: it brings no energy, never a question mark and never On plan

ac.title: On the plate it counts as 0
ac.text: Given skyr, oats and a banana are on the Plate, when I add 300 g of the tea, then the plate's energy and protein stay as they were and its weight grows by 300 g

ac.title: In a dish too
ac.text: Given a recipe uses the tea or a zero drink as an ingredient, when it is saved or cooked, then the ingredient keeps its grams and adds no energy, as zero cola does today

ac.title: Any other product with no values gets a heads-up
ac.text: Given I scan a biscuit whose database entry has a name and no values, when the label check opens, then one line says The name is read, but the database has no values for this product. Type them from the nutrition table on the pack, then save. The values are empty, the box I checked the values is there, and saving it empty still stops with the same lines as today

ac.title: A tea with values is as today
ac.text: Given I scan a tea whose database entry has values, when the label check opens, then the values are the database's and the box I checked the values is there, as today

unchanged: The barcode flow, the photos of the pack and the credit.
A product with values, of any kind.
Zero foods with a printed 0 (zero cola, sweeteners) stay as they are.
Herbs and spices used For cooking stay named and not counted.
details: The pictures are the real app on one scratch build of main, not committed. The database's answer is given in place of it. A board for food scanning needs no time on the phone, so the screens carry no time strip.
The server also asks the product database for the product's category (categories_tags), so the rule does not rest on the name alone.
The line names what it is: A tea, A coffee, A water, Salt.
Herbs and spices are not in this ticket: dried ones carry real energy per 100 g. They stay as today.
The plate's weight grows by the tea's grams, as for any drink on a plate.
short: A tea with no values is saved as 0
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
